body.statement: For a finite \(C_\alpha>0\) depending only on \(\alpha\) and the fixed class constants, \[\limsup_{N\to\infty}\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_N(u)}\frac{E_P[\ell(C_N^{\mathrm{AR}})]}{\min\{1,u^{-1/2}\}}\le C_\alpha\] uniformly over admissible \(u=u_N>0\) with nonempty \(\mathcal M_N(u)\).
body.justification: The confidence interval automatically shortens at the collection-information rate.
body.gap: Weak-IV inversion results do not establish bounded-ratio expected-length rates under a trial-support hypergraph.
body.consumer: Evidence-synthesis teams can value a trial that covers only selected target cells.
